result.title: ATLAS: Attention-Guided Test-Time Latent Selection for Compositional Visual Autoregressive Generation
result.summary: Visual autoregressive models produce convincing images but can misassign attributes and spatial relations. Searching multiple generation paths can improve composition, yet completing every candidate is costly. We introduce ATLAS, a training-free framework that uses the frozen generator's internal attention to guide search before final images are available. Within-prompt diagnostics identify attention-derived scores that predict final compositional preferences on Infinity, with category-dependent transfer to Switti. ATLAS uses these on-the-fly signals to progressively concentrate computation on promising trajectories. It maintains multiple coarse alternatives, prunes candidates without decoding at intermediate scales, and reserves image-space evaluation for a final choice among partial trajectories. ATLAS scales effectively on both backbones, achieving higher mean scores on the evaluated T2I-CompBench and GenEval categories as more computation is devoted to search. At the largest tested budget, the targeted T2I-CompBench mean improves by over 10% relative to each backbone. Separate profiles show over 50% less generation time than completing and evaluating all candidates at equal initial counts, alongside lower peak allocated GPU memory. Relative time savings are larger at the higher tested candidate count. Together, these results support scalable compositional search: additional sampling expands exploration, while attention-guided selection limits continuation cost without parameter updates or gradient-based optimization.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 ATLAS 框架，利用冻结视觉自回归生成器内部的注意力信号，在图像解码前对多条候选生成轨迹打分、剪枝并分配计算，以改善组合性并降低生成成本，在 Infinity、Switti 两个骨干及 T2I-CompBench、GenEval 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用内部注意力分数在解码前筛选、剪枝 latent 候选轨迹」的做法，可能为 LVR 中的 latent 假设筛选、注意力结构读取与提前停止/计算分配提供可借鉴线索；但原文研究对象是组合式图像生成而非多模态推理，迁移性需人工核查。
